issues.should_add: Complete preprocessor documentation including --pre flag, --pre-glob flag, use cases, examples, and best practices
issues.fix_suggestion: Populate chapter with content from GUIDE.md preprocessor section and expand with additional details

issues.description: Chapter needs explanation of --pre flag and how preprocessors work
issues.should_add: Explain that --pre takes a command that transforms files before searching. Command receives file path as first argument and file content on stdin, outputs transformed content to stdout.
issues.fix_suggestion: Add introduction explaining preprocessor concept and basic --pre flag usage with simple examples

issues.description: Chapter needs the canonical PDF search example with pdftotext
issues.should_add: Complete example showing PDF search using pdftotext, including shell script wrapper and performance comparison with pdfgrep
issues.fix_suggestion: Add comprehensive PDF search section from GUIDE.md showing preprocessing workflow and benefits

issues.description: Chapter needs documentation of --pre-glob flag for selective preprocessing
issues.should_add: Explain --pre-glob flag that limits preprocessor to files matching glob pattern, with performance comparison showing overhead reduction
issues.fix_suggestion: Add section on --pre-glob with examples showing performance improvement when preprocessing is limited to specific file types

issues.description: Chapter needs best practice guidance for robust preprocessors
issues.should_add: Example preprocessor script that handles multiple file types safely, checks file is non-empty, uses file utility for content sniffing
issues.fix_suggestion: Add section showing evolution from simple to robust preprocessor with file type detection and error handling

issues.description: Chapter should explain relationship between --pre and -z/--search-zip flags
issues.should_add: Explain that -z/--search-zip is built-in preprocessing for compressed files (gzip, bzip2, xz, lz4, lzma, brotli, zstd), and when to use --pre vs -z
issues.fix_suggestion: Add section comparing --pre (custom preprocessing) with -z (built-in compression support) and when to use each

issues.description: Chapter needs comprehensive list of preprocessor use cases beyond PDF
issues.should_add: Document use cases: PDF text extraction, decompression, decryption, encoding conversion, document format conversion (Office docs, etc.)
issues.fix_suggestion: Add use cases section with examples for different file types and transformations

issues.description: Chapter should document preprocessor performance impact and mitigation
issues.should_add: Explain preprocessor overhead (new process per file), importance of --pre-glob for limiting scope, and parallelism benefits for large file sets
issues.fix_suggestion: Add performance tips section showing benchmarks and best practices

issues.description: Chapter should mention security implications of preprocessors
issues.should_add: Note CVE-2021-3013 security fix and best practices for safe preprocessor scripts (path handling, command injection risks)
issues.fix_suggestion: Add security note warning about arbitrary command execution and safe scripting practices

issues.description: Chapter should include how to test preprocessor scripts
issues.should_add: Show how to test preprocessor scripts independently and verify ripgrep integration works correctly
issues.fix_suggestion: Add testing/debugging section showing manual preprocessor testing and common issues
